claims.text: A Malkavian of the 8th Generation, Embraced in 322 BCE, perhaps by Lykia; a general who watched Alexander's empire tear itself apart after his death.

title: Lizette Cordoba
summary: A Toreador of the Occupy protests.

claims.text: A Toreador of the 10th Generation, Embraced in 2011 by Avery; once a high school English teacher in New York who loved poetry.
Lizette is a queen of the Occupy movement in that city, keeping it simmering, neither winning nor failing.
A Lasombra of the 7th Generation, Embraced in 747 CE by Antipater of the Hoof; a man of Petra who even took up Christianity to fit in with the Roman-ruled elite.
Now a wanderer who wonders whether any of the Nabataean kind remain.

title: Azrael (Svein Fortinbras)
summary: A Setite of Norwegian black metal.

claims.text: Born in Bergen in 1970, Svein rose in the Norwegian black metal scene of the early 1990s and was Embraced in 1991 by Brynjar, a Follower of Set of the 12th Generation.
Kindred watch Azrael's music warily, unsure what is planned.

title: Lady Margaret Willoughby
summary: A Tremere made from a would-be witch.

claims.text: A Tremere of the 9th Generation, perhaps antitribu, Embraced in 1864; sire Lady Lise Paulmann is destroyed.
The Tremere lord Hargau courted Paulmann and Willoughby, two amateur witches, and drew both into the clan.

title: Meixiu
summary: A Malkavian bound for the East.

claims.text: A Malkavian of the 10th Generation, Embraced in 1989 by Colin McAllister; each night the delusion of being the Black Dragon Princess, heir of the Yellow Emperor, grows stronger.
The Camarilla courts the Cathayans by hosting Eastern emissaries; far more rarely a Western Kindred goes east to deal with them directly.
A Brujah of the 8th Generation, Embraced in 1736 by Katherine Wiese, who released Edgardo early in the nineteenth century.
Edgardo took work from mortals and Kindred alike, and in the 1970s grew close to the Baader-Meinhof Group.

title: Dastur Anosh
summary: The martyred founder of the Black Hand.

claims.text: An Assamite antitribu of the 5th Generation, sired by the Weeping Master; Black Hand apocrypha says Anosh was born in Persia and walked with Zarathustra.
After Anosh's Final Death the Black Hand made the duties into the title of Seraph, and appoints four Seraphs in tribute.
Recruits went on pilgrimage to the Weeping Stone to taste Zillah's vitae and take the black crescent; Anosh killed the Tzimisce Bishop Altzay in Monomacy for questioning that loyalty.
Anosh later led the Black Hand in the New World from a refuge on Mount Washington in New England.
A Toreador of the 8th Generation, Embraced in 1790 by Aimeric de Sauveterre, at home on the Côte d'Azur among the very rich; Villon sees a former Anarch self in Laurette.
A Nosferatu of the 8th Generation, Embraced in 1614 by Stanford Warwick, who found Maryann burned yet alive in a tavern after a Ventrue purge of the sire's servants.
Active in clan politics, Maryann champions and invests in ShreckNet and clashes with users who spread disinformation.
A Ventrue of the 7th Generation, Embraced in 1263 by Palamon the Copt; a few childhood memories of the mountains are all that remain from before Egypt.

title: Marc de Brabant
summary: A Gangrel lord of border domains.

claims.text: Given as a child to a Benedictine priory in the twelfth century, Marc ran away at sixteen and was Embraced in 1216 by Megan of Bristol, a Gangrel of the 10th Generation.
Travellers crossing Marc's border domains owe tribute or tithe.

title: Roderigo al-Dakhil
summary: A Nagaraja agent of the True Hand.

claims.text: Once a Castilian soldier fighting to retake Cadiz, Roderigo was Embraced in 1354 by Mokhadaji Ranpur, a Nagaraja of the 6th Generation.
Roderigo recruits agents by quietly aiding ambitious Kindred, both for the True Hand and for private ends; some former agents say the Hand's power is being gathered for personal use.

title: Andrew Seneca
summary: A Ventrue foe of the Anarchs.

claims.text: Born a slave on a Georgia cotton plantation and taken into the house as manservant to Jackson Mills; Embraced in 1807 by Monica San Valentin, Ventrue of the 8th Generation.
Now a sworn enemy of the Anarchs, bitter at their part in the success of the Civil Rights movement.

title: Jaromir Cerny
summary: An Old Clan Tzimisce of Prague.

claims.text: Old Clan Tzimisce of the 8th Generation, Embraced in 1989 by Janek Ritka; dissident parents were arrested in Prague under Gustav Husak.
More than twenty years have passed since the Velvet Revolution ended four decades of fear.

title: Colm Olliver
summary: A Brujah freed from a stake.

claims.text: A Brujah of the 11th Generation, Embraced in 1974 by Fat Ciaran; ambushed and staked on a farm truck bound for London in 1976, then left in torpor three years.

title: Esperanza Lucifer
summary: A Lasombra role that outlives its players.

claims.text: Lasombra of the 5th Generation, Embraced in 1812 by one known as Mary; when one Esperanza Lucifer falls, a new one takes up the fearsome role.
A Cappadocian of the 6th Generation, Embraced between 500 and 550 BCE by the Malenchaenos; born a slave to Ygratt, a warrior of the Scythians.
Nominally a Bishop of the Sabbat, Apacia leads a tattooed motorcycle gang and is often picked to lead crusades.
Roderigo al-Dakhil discovered Apacia while investigating the Giovanni.
